limitations: Source and column metadata only; no production rows, credentials, backups or external links opened.
POSM local files cannot be verified by a PostgreSQL+MinIO server restore.
Historical source names Medusa do not authorize requests to its obsolete origin.
classification_rules: Never fetch any URL during offline reference checking. An external URL is external_unchecked, not missing_local.
Use exact approved origin/path-to-storage mappings supplied by root; no hostname guessing from table names.
Managed /s3/<bucket>/<key> or s3://<bucket>/<key> must match an approved bucket manifest, URL-decode the path consistently, reject traversal/unsupported encodings.
Same-origin /downloads/* belongs to server /srv/epharm-downloads, not to MinIO.
Generated certificate/report/export/proxy routes and QR payloads do not imply stored files.
Null/empty optional values are absent references, not missing objects. A malformed nonempty value is invalid_reference and must not be silently ignored.
Extract only listed typed JSON paths. Preserve opaque JSON/text, but do not regex every text string as a physical path.
Certificate PDF branding reads only managed UUID PNG/JPEG keys, limited to 5 MiB. A preserved external branding URL still may not render; classify this separately.

non_file_columns.why: Despite its name and admin hint, current Flutter renders this as ordinary Text, not a Markdown image/link widget. Preserve prose; do not invent inline object references.
Original uploaded filename for import history only; ExcelImportService parses bytes and persists row data, no source Excel object upload.
Display filename; media_url is the locator.
Text lesson parser renders headings/lists/plain strings, not raw HTML media. A typed URL in prose is not automatically a missing object.
Question/option/explanation text, no typed media field; keep JSON, never export answer keys in file reports.
Integrity/provenance metadata only, not file key/URL; artifact_format/source/fiscal fields likewise are not locators.
Inspected physical products table has no image/media column. Product images are promos URLs or MedusaProduct-shaped saved payload fields; do not invent products.image_url.
Typed RuleCard has presentation/comparison/goal/rank fields, no media URL.
Typed notification payload currently holds event/program labels, times/bonus, not a persisted media URL. Preserve payload, but do not treat arbitrary prose as object paths.
